title: Issuance request schema and validation
acceptance: Request carries session_public_key, role, session_handle, epoch, proof_of_possession, request_nonce, request_timestamp and no role list or epoch bounds
Freshness uses DV-ATA-04 and skew uses DV-ATA-07
A session record must exist and the epoch must not have ended beyond G
findings: Correction: imported plan carried declared_roles in the request, which a requester could set freely.
